subject: Geopolitics
title: Conflict Minerals
description: A quick win: understand Conflict Minerals.

hook.text: Your smartphone contains tantalum from Congo. Armed militias control the mines. Your tech funds their bullets.

buildup.text: Conflict minerals — tin, tantalum, tungsten, and gold — are mined in war zones and sold to fund armed groups.

discovery.text: The profits fund warlords who control territory through violence. Mining communities live under their rule.

twist.text: Laws like Dodd-Frank require companies to trace supply chains. But enforcement is weak and loopholes are wide.

climax.text: As demand for electronics grows, conflict mineral extraction rises. Every new device has a hidden cost.

punchline.text: The device in your hand carries a conflict inside.
